g.text: Every agent call goes through one gateway: route, call, retry, fall back, validate, repair, record.
task class, output schema, prompt version
verified models get response_format json_schema or
json_object; others get none and rely on validation
timeouts and deadlines. They are unavailable when
not configured and in demo mode. An image never
call is capped at 2.5 times that timeout
validate against the Pydantic output schema
the model is asked to fix the reported validation errors
StepTrace for every stage, stored in agent_runs.steps
stage, agent, provider, model_id, prompt_version, schema_version, latency_ms, retries, fallback_used, sampling, usage
Prompts and outputs are never logged. Demo projects
use a fixture provider with no external call.
